correct_query: SELECT T1.service_tier, T1.carrier_id FROM carriers AS T1 INNER JOIN transfers AS T2 ON T1.carrier_id = T2.carrier_id WHERE SUBSTRING(T2.source_code, 4, 2) = '12'

expected_mutants_to_kill.description: Mutant relaxes a SUBSTRING equality predicate by adding an OR branch on a secondary column and applying + 0 numeric coercion
expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT C.service_tier, C.carrier_id FROM carriers AS C INNER JOIN transfers AS T ON C.carrier_id = T.carrier_id WHERE SUBSTRING(T.source_code, 4, 2) + 0 = 12 OR SUBSTRING(T.source_code2, 4, 2) + 0 = 12
